The '''Praxlis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Praxlis sector/Legends|Praxlis sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The home system of [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]], it was home to [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that served the detachment.<ref name="BF1">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the production of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Intimidator'']] was transferred from the yards of Black Sword Command in the Praxlis system and moved to the [[Black Fifteen]] base at [[N'zoth]].<ref name="BF1" />
